visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In a brightly lit banquet hall, a group of people, including a bride in a white gown and a man in a formal suit, are gathered. One person has a white napkin draped over their head and is holding a smartphone, apparently acting as the photographer in a game. (2) The scene shifts rapidly as the participants start moving and dodging each other. The bride and other guests are seen laughing and crouching to avoid being 'caught' in the photo. (3) Individual reactions are captured in quick cuts: the bride laughs heartily, a woman in a beige dress ducks away, and an older woman in a checkered outfit strikes a dramatic pose. (4) The game continues with energetic movements and playful interactions. A man in a yellow cap joins the laughter as the 'photographer' with the cloth over their head keeps chasing the group. (5) The video concludes with the whole group converging in laughter, pointing at the person under the cloth as they all pose together for a final chaotic moment.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat, quirky electronic music with a strong rhythmic pulse begins, accompanied by the sounds of multiple female voices laughing and chattering in an echoing hall. (2) A sharp 'ding' sound effect triggers a pause in the music, coinciding with a visual freeze. (3) The music resumes at its original tempo. Laughter continues as a dominant layer, mixed with low-level background chatter. (4) A male voice shouts 'Hey, don't grab my ass!' in Mandarin, followed by another sharp percussion hit that pauses the music again. (5) The audio cycles through these rapid sequences of music-bursts and sudden silences, ending with a final chorus of high-pitched laughter and cheering voices.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To entertain viewers with a humorous and energetic social game played among family members at a wedding, highlighting a festive and bonding atmosphere.
